sourcePolicy: Three genuine Spanish Android 1.0.16 (19) captures from existing test APK, obtained with official adb in a fresh isolated API 35 emulator using the previously authorized screenshot method. App settings switched to Español; no source edits or APK rebuild. Four compositions; reward and notes image reuse the actual candidate board. Only Android system bars cropped; entire app uniformly scaled, captions outside UI. No redrawing or AI bitmap assets.
